releaseName: ADC Software 8.5 Standard · License and Edition Fix
releaseNotes: Fix: Existing offline product key no longer changes ADC 8.5 Standard branding to Pro without the actual Pro features.
Added License & Edition page and Switch to Standard action; only the legacy licence record is removed, without deleting patient records.
Removed licensed status wording from the titlebar and startup splash; the topbar now says Explore 8.5 Pro.
Added Pro Features catalogue for 12 planned premium modules, clearly labeled Not yet released.
Changed proposed Pro price to PKR 9,999 per month; 3 months shown at PKR 29,997, with no falsely enforced expiry.
Added permanently visible release notes under Settings → Software Updates; all changes are also in update.json.
Retained prior receipt discount lines, decorative non-scannable QR, smoother right drawer, developer options, and Kharian doctors directory.
Security: Time-limited subscriptions and payment validation require an actual server-side license service in the future Pro release.
